formula_review_records.title: Accounting and taxes
formula_review_records.expression: Q=sum(disjoint gross expense lines); exclusive gross=round(q*r*(1+t/100)); inclusive gross=round(q*r), net=round(q*r/(1+t/100))
formula_review_records.finding: Tax and compound service charges, single-level inclusion map, deposits and rounding need review

formula_review_records.title: Paid duration
formula_review_records.expression: Hpaid=Hsetup+Hevent+Hclear; Hregular=min(Hpaid,Hlimit); Hovertime=max(0,Hpaid-Hregular)
formula_review_records.finding: Actual paid breaks, role scope and overtime agreement missing. Date span is not paid duration; direct hour/overtime boundary checks added in Stage 2 verification

formula_review_records.title: Seating and furniture demand
formula_review_records.expression: N=ceil(seated_share*G); tables=ceil((N-VIP)/seats_per_table)+VIP_tables; VIP<=N<=G and VIP<=VIP_tables*seats_per_table
formula_review_records.finding: Single table capacity for VIP and standard tables must fit plan. Seat share is A008, guest occupancy is A005

formula_review_records.title: Usable venue area
formula_review_records.expression: U=V-excluded_area; 0<U<=V
formula_review_records.finding: Need measured plan; capacity is not floor area

formula_review_records.title: Area allocation
formula_review_records.expression: Standard=(N-VIP)*a_standard; VIP_area=VIP*a_vip; non-overlapping service and circulation areas
formula_review_records.finding: Densities/circulation not observed. No fire-safety certification

formula_review_records.title: Stage and independent package steps
formula_review_records.expression: S=width*length; separately choose AV and lighting units from first reviewed max_stage_area_m2>=S
formula_review_records.finding: Legacy register/R03 uses ceil-area expression; amended engine uses independent steps. Zero stage is accepted by engine, but original positive-dimension scope needs a decision

formula_review_records.title: Spatial constraints
formula_review_records.expression: Used=(N-VIP)*a_standard+VIP*a_vip+S+service+circulation; Used<=U and G<=C
formula_review_records.finding: No automatic layout adaptation. Invalid layout blocks; if N<G no standing-person area is explicitly allocated. Restrict review POC to N=G until amendment

formula_review_records.title: Package catering
formula_review_records.expression: Catering quantity=planned G; charge G*approved per-person package rate once, subject to reviewed inclusion map
formula_review_records.finding: No ingredient BOM, wastage, minimum guests or adult/child tiers implemented. Quotes requiring these are not compatible without amendments

formula_review_records.title: Disjoint equipment ledger
formula_review_records.expression: Chairs=N; tables from A008; stage=S; other equipment fixed booking line; each applicable line charged once
formula_review_records.finding: Item-day rates need duration conversion. Equipment aggregate is not a single podium price

formula_review_records.title: General staff and billing hours
formula_review_records.expression: Staff=base+ceil(G/guests_per_staff)+extra; physical person_hours=Staff*Hpaid; billing quantity=Staff*(Hregular+Hovertime*multiplier)
formula_review_records.finding: General pool excludes vendor/security staff. Formula implies at least one ratio-based staff member when G>0; all-staff-bundled cases need a scope amendment

formula_review_records.title: Venue billing
formula_review_records.expression: Venue=approved fixed booking amount + Hevent*approved hourly tariff; each line normalized for tax
formula_review_records.finding: Current formula bills all event hours. Included-hour and clock-time surcharges do not fit without a reviewed extension

formula_review_records.title: Budget constraint
formula_review_records.expression: B fixed before outcomes; reserve=c*Q; require B>=reserve; planned breaches compare Q>B and Q>B-reserve
formula_review_records.finding: If experimental B=b*Qreference is selected, calculate once for baseline and freeze for What-If pairs. Never recalculate B from realized cost

formula_review_records.title: Retained receipts and profit
formula_review_records.expression: Planned profit=expected retained receipts-Q; realized profit=realized retained receipts-realized cost
formula_review_records.finding: Do not equate client total turnover or pass-through cash with retained receipts. No receipt amount inferred from desired profit

formula_review_records.title: Margin policy
formula_review_records.expression: Margin_points=100*profit/receipts when receipts>0; compare to separately selected minimum_margin_points
formula_review_records.authority: Explicit user policy review plus supervisor
formula_review_records.finding: Zero receipts gives null margin, not a safe zero-risk label. Policy threshold is not industry average

formula_review_records.title: Contingency funding
formula_review_records.expression: Reserve=round(c*Q); operating allowance=B-Reserve; Reserve excluded from Q and profit expenses
formula_review_records.authority: Explicit user policy review plus accountant/supervisor
formula_review_records.finding: Unspent reserve is funding, not expense. Reserve fraction does not represent a calibrated confidence level

formula_review_records.title: Planning estimate
formula_review_records.expression: Forecasted_Total_Cost=Q for this provisional deterministic POC; historical event mean/vendor volatility remain null
formula_review_records.finding: No Prophet forecast or trained-model prediction. Retail history cannot replace observed event outcomes

formula_review_records.title: Budget outcome label
formula_review_records.expression: Budget_Overrun=1[round(realized cost)>round(B)] if valid nonnegative operands; equality=0
formula_review_records.finding: Actual outcomes unavailable. Future synthetic labels require origin and frozen ex-ante budget; planned flag is not target

formula_review_records.title: Margin outcome label
formula_review_records.expression: Profit_Margin_Risk=1[100*(realized receipts-realized cost)/realized receipts < required margin]; receipts<=0 => null
formula_review_records.finding: Tested arithmetic does not validate market outcomes. Outcome and injected flags excluded from planning features

formula_review_records.title: Version and identity binding
formula_review_records.expression: Engine fingerprint=SHA256(sorted compact JSON); parameter payload includes parameters/rates/billing/steps/override bounds; pilot binds full configuration and count
formula_review_records.finding: Draft hashes identify content, not completeness, signatures or permission. Seed/RNG/source cutoff remain unresolved

formula_review_records.title: Supplied injection flag utility
formula_review_records.expression: Vendor_Cost_Anomaly=int(flag) only if a boolean injection flag is supplied; otherwise null
formula_review_records.authority: Supervisor and relevant financial/venue reviewer; parent assumptions still require approval
formula_review_records.finding: Boolean truth conversion exists for explicit software-test outcomes. Regime generator and real anomaly detector do not exist

formula_review_records.title: Paired planning differences
formula_review_records.expression: Delta cost=Qalt-Qbase; delta profit=Palt-Pbase; delta used_area=Aalt-Abase; all deltas null unless both calculations valid
formula_review_records.authority: Supervisor and relevant financial/venue reviewer; parent assumptions still require approval
formula_review_records.finding: Planning estimates only. Baseline inputs fixed; policy options not automatically activated; no probability or ML explanation

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Test financially tight, break-even and funded planning cases; not observed affordability
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Use independently approved baseline Qreference once; freeze B across paired interventions; B>=reserve

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Zero-reserve control plus proposed 5/10/15/20% sensitivity; not a market standard
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: B includes reserve. Reserve not operating expense. Select policy before outcomes

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Zero-profit threshold control and original policy sensitivity; not empirical margins
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Keep retained receipts independent; equality meets threshold; zero receipts => null margin

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Within original .50–1.00 capacity scope; not measured wedding attendance
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Positive integer guests after declared rounding; measured layout and capacity still bind

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Within original .30–.90 scope; not measured corporate attendance
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Positive integer guests; event-specific seated capacity and geometry required

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Seated-only POC control, not observed wedding practice
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Still pending user/expert approval. Lower share deferred: current engine lacks explicit standing-person area

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Seated-only POC control, not an occupancy safety standard
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Still pending user/expert approval. Mixed/standing share options deferred pending reviewed standing-area extension

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Bounded duration sensitivity proposed for this review, not actual schedules
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Venue availability/billing and paid setup/clearance/shift contracts constrain selection

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Paired size interventions around measured/approved baseline, not real-stage distribution
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Scaling one dimension vs both is a separate choice. Square multiplier applies if both dimensions scaled. Actual bounds and steps remain null

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: No-shock and ±5/10/20% stress levels, not probabilities or intervals
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Apply selected factor to declared disjoint net service rates, then recompute taxes/ledger. Never inject into planning inputs

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Bounded receipt stress, not measured cancellation or demand rates
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Nonnegative retained receipts, ex-ante expectation independent. Latent factor restricted to diagnostic outcome sidecar

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Compare joint stress designs without inventing correlation coefficients
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: No stochastic distribution/covariance inferred. Predeclare selected grid subset; no target-prevalence tuning

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Explore injection severity as separate latent intervention, not actual fraud
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Declare affected service and ordinary-shock composition once. Prevalence and actual service set remain null; labels unavailable without approved regime

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Coverage is research design, not Sri Lankan event prevalence
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Weights, record count and grouped partitions remain null; no pilot authorization

experimental_policy_proposals.rationale: Avoid invented residual distribution when outcomes are unavailable
experimental_policy_proposals.constraints: Later generator/gate adapter requires reviewed implementation; deterministic grid is not implemented or auto-authorized

proposed_input_policy.venue_geometry: fixed measured reviewed profile, not generated observations
proposed_input_policy.budget: fixed ex-ante LKR domain; currently null
proposed_input_policy.event_date: uniform integer day inside reviewed interval; currently null
